lines.text:
"Look at me! You're blocking my way!"  
"I'll get past you first, then I'll deal with the rest."
I will never let you strangle me and I want to stab both of us in the face.
"I won't stop you from doing what I do, but if you're going to attack me or my friends, then we'll have a fight."
I want to stab you in the face and kill you.

"Then I'll show you why no one dares to challenge me!"  
"You think a simple jutsu like that can stop the Naruto of my generation?"  
"Let's see if you're worthy to become a shinobi!"

I'm gonna die by your hand! Just kill me and watch you suffer.
I want to stay on the bridge with you, but I need to find a way to kill me properly and make sure we don't fight.

"You speak of death as if it's your desire!"  
"I'll cross the river and stand firm against any who seek my demise."  
"Let's see if you're truly the one I am looking for!"
I want to kill you like a good samurai does.
I see the light in your eyes, just as I must. Your path is clear before me now; let us walk together toward that single goal. We will not give it up, for the light means everything to us.
